hypothesis: Shared-paper-first candidate-pool alpha: an official EIA WPSR first-release broad de-stocking shock across commercial crude excluding SPR, total motor gasoline, and distillate inventories may precede ten-session excess returns in a fixed equal-notional diversified U.S. energy equity basket; use only archived issue bytes and actual release availability, enter the first strictly later regular-session open, and never split or retune the three-series composite.
next_retry_requires: At least 30 prospectively closed decisions under the unchanged first-release policy, with positive replacement value against cash, XLE, USO, SPY, and QQQ.
Alternatively, a genuinely new physical-supply signal or data source; changing a threshold, series subset, basket weight, response shape, hold, or cost is not new evidence.
notes: Rejected despite +0.0707 aggregate EV and +$1,380.90: only 11 settled release events, old_thin EV/PnL regression, top-5 positive contribution 75.55%, USO comparator loss, and accepted comparator not beaten. Gate2/source PIT and Gate3 16.05% passed. DSR is not computable for one honest attempt; no run.py or live behavior changed.

locked_variables: versioned archived EIA WPSR Table 4 first-release bytes and actual release availability
three rows fixed to Commercial Excluding SPR Total Motor Gasoline and Distillate Fuel Oil
weekly percent change minus prior-five-year same-ISO-week-plus-minus-two median with at least fifteen observations
composite equals negative equal-weight mean of the three seasonal excess changes
trigger requires at least two negative excess changes and composite strictly above trailing-104-issue 80th percentile
fixed basket XOM CVX COP EOG OXY SLB BKR MPC VLO PSX
1000 USD per eligible leg and no missing-leg redistribution
event requires at least eight of ten legs with price at least 10 USD ADV20 at least 50 million USD and complete bars
entry first regular-session open strictly after release
matched XLE USO SPY QQQ cash and accepted-comparator checks
no series threshold percentile basket hold cost or window retune

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not split the three-series composite or retune the seasonal radius/history, breadth, p80, cooldown, fixed basket, weights, liquidity, ATR target, 10-session hold, cost, or canonical windows on this frozen sample.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only after at least 30 prospectively closed unchanged-policy EIA decisions with positive matched replacement value, or with a genuinely new physical-supply signal/data source.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The locked basket was positive and beat cash, XLE, SPY, and QQQ, but the gain was too thin and concentrated and USO earned roughly twice the matched PnL.

prediction.confidence_reason: The source and release vintages are genuinely new and the archive provides 81 canonical-window issues with complete fixed-basket OHLCV, but the policy will likely retain only about one fifth of weekly event clusters and energy beta may already be fully priced by the next open.

rejection_reason: The locked policy had positive aggregate EV/PnL but failed Gate 4 on one regressed window, only 11/12 settled events, 75.55% top-five contribution, USO outperformance, and both accepted-candidate comparator bars.
fingerprint_caveat: Reservation-time classification incorrectly routed the new EIA source to companyfacts_ratio/notional_scalar. This experiment added narrow eia_wpsr_inventory/event_basket_10d fingerprint coverage; the rebuilt frozen-family entry uses the corrected key.
